Show transcript IGN 19.8M subscribers VideosAboutTwitterFacebookInstagramTikTok Show less Marvel Rivals - Official Season 7.5 Dev Vision Vol. 1613,959 views13K viewsApr 14, 2026340ShareSaveDownload Download Shop the IGN store Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - Monoco 1-6 Scale Special Edition - Statue $385.00 IGN Store "Count me in then."Let’s be real, every great quest needs a loyal (usually furry) companion to steal the show. Enter Monoco, powerful magic user, foot aficionado, and certified “best boy” that’s always got Verso’s back if there’s a fight.IGN Store is incredibly excited to reveal the Monoco statue; a 1/6th scale polystone officially licensed Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 statue. This is a high-end tribute to the lovable and feisty Gestral, produced to exacting standards for serious collectors.Special EditionWe wanted to do something extra for the folks who are there on Day 1. The Special Edition is available for pre-order only for the next 14 days (before midnight Pacific Time on May 7th) and includes an exclusive second staff, the Joyaro, as well as an individually numbered base, and Certificate of Authenticity.Product Details: The only officially-licensed Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 Monoco 1/6 Scale Statue Materials: Polystone Dimensions: Special Edition 1:6 Scale Statue 44.5cm x 36.8cm x 30.5cm 17.5in x 14.5in x 12in Includes additional Joyaro staff accessory, giving you multiple ways to showcase Monaco’s fighting spirit Includes Certificate of Authenticity Each base will be individually numbered Product will ship from both US and European warehouses Estimated Release Date: Q4 2026 Artists: Conceptual Design: Brandon Cahoe Sculpt and Prototype: MerchAux Creative Team Photography: Cassie Fuertez Item shown is a prototype. When shipped, the final production piece may differ in appearance. Shop IGN Store Expedition 33 x RockLove - Esquie Necklace - Limited Edition of 333 $250.00 IGN Store Product Details Official licensed Expedition 33 product Limited edition of 333 engraved with unique series number Nickel-free sterling silver and 14K yellow gold plate, enamel 21 inch sterling curb chain 26mm x 25mm x 6mm (not including bail) Product Features Designed by RockLove, this exclusive release is limited to just 333 pieces worldwide, with each necklace individually engraved with its unique series number. Once sold out, the edition will be permanently retired, making it a rare acquisition for dedicated fans and collectors.Inspired by Esquie himself and his serene presence and quiet optimism, the Esquie Necklace captures the spirit of this beloved character from Clair Obscur: Expedition 33. Designed in collaboration with the game’s creators, Sandfall Interactive, every element has been carefully translated from in-game references into a wearable design, preserving his distinctive features and symbolic details in a collectible piece that bridgescharacter design and fine jewelry craftsmanship.Handcrafted in solid, nickel-free sterling silver and finished with luminous 14K yellow gold plating, the pendant features Esquie’s face surrounded by radiant golden rays, capturing his calm and joyful expression. Polished to a mirror finish, Esquie’s face is domed, with etched and hand-painted enamel details in subtle grey tones that add depth and dimension to the design.The geometric sun-like rays, rendered in their distinctive in-game geometry, encircle the head and are plated in warm 14K yellow gold, creating a striking contrast against the bright silver. On the reverse of the pendant, each piece is engraved with its unique running number, alongside Esquie’s signature “33” as seen on his headband in-game, etched and blackened for contrast, a meaningful detail that connects the jewelry to his story. The pendant hangs from a 21-inch sterling silver curb chain with a secure lobster clasp, offering a versatile unisex fit suited to everyday wear or display.The Expedition 33 | RockLove Jewelry BoxThis jewelry design arrives in a sophisticated Expedition 33 | RockLove Jewelry Box featuring the brand’s logo in metallic gold, accented by the game’s signature Art Deco–inspired geometric linework inside and out. The jewelry is framed by a soft black flocked insert with Expedition 33 branding and includes a luxury travel pouch. Estimated Release Date: Q3 2026 Manufacturer: RockLove Jewelry About RockLove Special Note: All sales are final. No returns, exchanges or refunds. Shop IGN Store Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - The Art of Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 Collectors Edition - Book $100.00 IGN Store Dive into the sumptuous video game world of Clair Obscur: Expedition 33, where imagination blends with emotion, and discover the secrets behind its remarkable creation. Bringing together testimonials from developer Sandfall Interactive with hundreds of stunning images, this making-of artbook takes readers on a journey through an extraordinary human and creative adventure. Development secrets, the creative process, artistic influences, design documents, and previously unseen illustrations lift the veil on this truly unique production. The Art of Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 is a fascinating and intimate look at the choices and inspirations that shaped this enchanting universe... from the very first sketches to the final renders. INCLUDES: The Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 book in English featuring an exclusive cover illustration printed in Pantone Gold and a cardboard slipcase in Alicia’s colors. A die-cut premium cardboard box. A gold-colored metal medallion. A cardboard folio containing 10 lithographs on textured paper. An individually numbered metal plaque. Dedicated packaging. Size: 352 pages, 8.25x11.75", full color, hardcover Manufacturer: Udon Estimated Release Date: Q4 2026 Shop IGN Store Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 Esquie Plush Replica | Official 12” Collectible $44.99 IGN Store Bring home Esquie from the 2025 Game of the Year. This official Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 Esquie Plush Replica stands 12” tall, ultra-soft, and highly detailed. Ships Spring 2026. Shop IGN Store Fallout - Pip-Boy 3000 - Replica $299.99 IGN Store A 1:1 FAITHFUL REPLICA OF THE PIP-BOY AS SEEN IN THE FALLOUT TV SERIES.A 1:1 faithful replica of the Pip-Boy 3000 Mk V as seen in the Fallout TV series. Created using the TV show geometry and made in a mix of die-cast metal and injection moulded ABS, the Pip-Boy has a functioning TFT LCD screen showing in-universe animations and is also a working timepiece with an in-universe alarm clock function – ideal for when it is sitting neatly on its perfectly-formed display stand.Die-cast metal front casing, engineering injection-moulded ABS body with a memory foam cuff, all come together in the perfect balance of authentic materials, which individually distressed by hand, result in the most accurate replica of this iconic wrist worn "Personal Information Processor" - Pip-Boy ever made.Discover the exciting range of animated screens straight out of the Fallout universe displayed in glorious monochrome green. Each screen is authentically accessed via the control dial on the side of the casing.The Pip-Boy 3000 Mk V display stand – elegant, carefully designed and perfectly balanced. Made from a solid machined and then formed aluminium slab overlaid with an ABS moulded Pip-Boy rest. It has a sandblast finish with a laser etched Fallout logo and finished underneath with a soft rubber EVA pad. At the back it has an integral socket holder to make sure that the USB-C charging cable is kept neat and tidy.The Pip-Boy's clock mode displays the time exactly as it does in the Fallout universe, which makes it a great super large watch for day-to-day wear, or just about the most perfect cosplay item money can buy. When it's not being worn, it can be shown off with pride on its slimline stand as a pure display piece or put to good use on your nightstand as an awesome clock, complete with an in-universe alarm mode. It is the perfect Pip-Boy. **The product images and descriptions are representative. Changes may be made to final products. FEATURES: Official merchandise from the Amazon Original series Fallout A perfect replica: Developed using the geometry used for the show props Die-cast front metal casing: Hand-painted weathered finish TFT LCD display with an exciting range of animated in-universe screens Timepiece with in-universe clock/watch display with alarm function Memory foam cuff liner: Increased comfort and universal fitting Display grade: The elegant solid formed and machined metal stand displays the Pip-Boy perfectly and also allows it to be used as a table clock Animated TFT LCD screen: Plays over 45 different screens taken directly from those shown on the Pip-Boy in the TV Show FM Radio: Use the FM radio to tune into your favorite station, or listen to authentic broadcasts from the Wasteland at the click of a button Rechargeable LiPo power cell: Recharge for use on the go, or power up via the USB-C cable supplied for a constantly-on desktop display From the minds at The Wand Company Shop IGN Store Cyberpunk Edgerunners - Hunted - Board Game + Preorder Bonus $39.99 IGN Store Cyberpunk: Edgerunners – Hunted is a board game where players tackle high-stakes missions in a gritty, futuristic world. It blends tactical decision-making with thematic gear and character progression. The game delivers immersive, fast-paced play with strong replay value.Cyberpunk: Edgerunners is a Netflix global exclusive that reached the Top 10 in 30+ countries, amassed an estimated 30–40 million viewers worldwide, and won Anime of the Year at the Crunchyroll Awards 2023. COMPONENTS: 90 TILES 1 TIME TRACK 1 HOURGLASS 17 MISSION/REPUTATION CARDS 11 CHARACTERS STANDEES 4 PLAYER BOARDS 12 CUBE MARKERS 2 SECRET ENVELOPES Preorders placed in April will receive additional components - 2 Acrylic standees and 2 exclusive mission/reputation card + 2 characters card.
